asA: definer at DEFINE and verifier at the TEST stage
iWant: each criterion to carry a proof level, full, journey or external, that test strength, the Test verdict and Finalise read
soThat: a buyer promise keeps the full mutation proof, a core journey is proved by an end-to-end test, and a deployed promise is proved by the release Verify, while a chain that sets no level behaves exactly as 0.40.1 did
description: Round G (0.41.0, T2, the stage-keeper's rulings 1 to 20): acceptanceCriterion.proof (rcf-schemas 0.11.0, enum full | journey | external, optional, no schema default), read by rcf audit test-strength, rcf build verdict test and rcf build finalise, carried by the writer; absent means full everywhere. Also the successors of AC-19502-3 to AC-19502-5 (FBS-232), whose Given names the pin at rcf-schemas 0.11.0 (ruling 17).
title: The definer sets each criterion's proof level at DEFINE, and every verb reads it, absent meaning full

acceptanceCriteria.description: [must-not] Given a fixture chain with no proof on any criterion (US-101 with AC-101-1 bound to an e2e-level test that kills the mutants of its symbol-level Code Node src/greet.js#greet, a REVIEW: MERGE/PASS commit for H touching AC-101-1, every fixture commit at fixed author and committer dates and the init-written declaredAt pinned), when rcf audit test-strength --record runs, then its stdout line, its exit code and the bytes of rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test-strength.json equal the golden test/cli/fixtures/test-strength-proof-absent-0-40-1.json generated from rcf-lite 0.40.1, every field compared in its order except exactly two, wallMs and node; a chain with no proof must not gain a proof field, a totals key or a line suffix (absent means full, everywhere: the stage-keeper's ruling 6).

[must-not] Given a criterion with verification external and no proof, rcf audit test-strength must not infer a level from the flag: it judges the criterion at full (explicit only: the stage-keeper's ruling 7). With no Code Node it exits 4 with the FAIL line naming "AC-101-1 no Code Node"; with a symbol-level Code Node the mutants run (totals.mutants above 0), a vacuous bound test fails it with result "fail" and exit 4, and the report carries no proof field on it.

[must-not] Given a criterion with proof journey bound to a test in an e2e-level suite (test-suite testLevel "e2e") and to a test in a unit-level suite that imports src/ directly, with a symbol-level Code Node whose mutants the e2e test would let survive, when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 runs, then the structural check reads the bound tests of e2e-level suites only and no mutant is built or run: it exits 0 with the line "test-strength: PASS 1 criteria at <H7>: structural 1/1, mutants killed 0/0 (timeout 0, notApplicable 0)", and --json reports the criterion with the keys acId, proof, structural, mutants, result in that order, proof "journey", structural { "result": "pass", "findings": [] }, mutants [] and result "pass", with totals.mutants 0 and no Code Node reason (the stage-keeper's ruling 9).

[failure] Given a criterion with proof journey whose only bound tests sit in a unit-level suite (no e2e-level bound test), when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1 runs, then it exits 4 with the line "test-strength: FAIL 1 of 1 criteria at <H7>: AC-101-1 journey: no e2e-level bound test", and --json reports the criterion with proof "journey", mutants [] and result "fail" (the stage-keeper's ruling 9).

[must-not] Given AC-101-1 at full with a strong bound test and its Code Node, and AC-101-2 with verification external and proof external bound to a vacuous test and with no Code Node, when rcf audit test-strength --acs AC-101-1,AC-101-2 runs, then AC-101-2 gets no structural check, no mutants and no Code Node reason: the command exits 0; --json reports AC-101-2 with exactly the keys acId, proof, structural, mutants, result, reason in that order, as proof "external", structural { "checked": false }, mutants [], result "notApplicable", reason "external: proved by the release Verify"; totals.criteria is 2 and totals.criteriaNotApplicable is 1 (a key present only when at least one criterion is external, so totals.notApplicable still counts mutants); result is "pass"; and the stdout line is the PASS line over the full criteria ("test-strength: PASS 2 criteria at <H7>: structural 1/1, mutants killed <k>/<n> (timeout <t>, notApplicable <m>)", the counts over the full criteria as today) followed by "; external 1: AC-101-2 (external: proved by the release Verify)", the external ids in id order, comma-separated (the stage-keeper's ruling 9).

[failure] Given AC-101-1 at full bound to a vacuous test, AC-101-2 and AC-101-3 each with verification external and proof external, and a REVIEW: MERGE/PASS commit for H touching all three, when rcf audit test-strength --record runs, then a mix still fails: it exits 4, the stdout line opens "test-strength: FAIL 1 of 3 criteria at <H7>: AC-101-1 vacuous:", and rcf/verdicts/<H12>/test-strength.json reads result "fail" with criteria AC-101-1 "fail", AC-101-2 "notApplicable" and AC-101-3 "notApplicable" in that order (the stage-keeper's ruling 11).

[failure] Given a fixture round on FBS-001 (DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW: MERGE/PASS touching AC-101-1 and AC-101-2, TEST: PASS) where AC-101-1 is at full with a Code Node and AC-101-2 has proof external and no Code Node, and the test-strength record at H reads AC-101-1 "pass" and AC-101-2 "notApplicable", when rcf build finalise FBS-001 --ci-run run-7 runs, then it exits 0 and FBS-001 reads complete; with the record reading AC-101-1 "fail" beside AC-101-2 "notApplicable" it exits 4 with the stderr line "finalise refused: test-strength at <H7> fails for AC-101-1", naming the full criterion only, and FBS-001 stays inProgress (the stage-keeper's ruling 9).
